_help: Phase-2 verification trace. Fill every null from ONE real run, then: node verify/run.mjs --trace verify/stage2-trace.json   Copy this file to stage2-trace.json first and keep the copy out of git (already in .gitignore).
_help_observedFrom: REQUIRED. The trace is refused without provenance so an example can never be mistaken for a real pass.
_help_run: One workflow run. stages[] is the parsed flowchart; upstream[] holds the NAMES of the stages this stage depends on (root stages get []). preset is the agent preset assigned to that stage.

run._help_subagents: One entry per subagent created for the run. seesOtherSubagents MUST be the list of OTHER subagent ids you can actually find inside that subagent's context; a correct isolated run gives [] for every entry.
run._help_artifacts: kind is either 'result' or 'flowchart'. bytes is the real file size on disk.

_help_library: R13: run once with the template library emptied/first-time. R14: run the SAME task a second time and record whether it reused the stored flowchart without re-splitting.
_help_management: R15: three separate operations on the template list. add/delete are counts before -> after; rename is the old and new name plus whether it took effect.
